description: Divisional Secretariate - Pasgoda - Annuala Religions Festival 2024 of Rotumba Pethmaga Ancient Temple (Rotumba Purana Rajamaha Viharaya) of Pasgoda D/S/Dvision Matara District.
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the dates for an annual religious festival at a specific temple.
